focused.scope: Before three additional borrowed-phone, named not-me and explicit proxy journeys; underlying monotonic denial unchanged.

limits: Bounded explicit complete patient/name changes and caller roles, borrowed-phone ownership and shared-number appointments; quoted/negated/background and ordinary introductions do not revoke authority.
Declarations revoke access conservatively; they do not identify a new patient, compare unverified names to records or establish proxy consent. Clinic contact is required for recovery.
The existing monotonic denial disposes grants, source/menu and message owners, cancels unsent proposals and retains public sent/unknown receipts.
No new patient lookup, name-to-record match, proxy permission, durable patient field or write path.
Synthetic signed voice/provider/mail/approval evidence only; no real carrier or clinic activation and no new real-model pass.
